root_cause.text: In `mb_cache_destroy()`, the pending or running `c_shrink_work` work item is not cancelled before the cache memory is freed, allowing a use-after-free when the work item subsequently accesses freed cache structures.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `cancel_work_sync(&cache->c_shrink_work)` before `shrinker_free()` and freeing entries, explicitly addressing the missing synchronization described in the commit message: "mb_cache_destroy() ... does not cancel the pending c_shrink_work work item first" and "mb_cache_shrink_worker() will access the cache after its memory has been freed, causing a use-after-free."
